content: Jesús, Roma-sorda-dummad-e-mai-nudaksad
Jesús bela dule-e-itobukmaladga ibmar-sogsad-sorba Capernaúmʼse dognonikid.
Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid-e-mai (100) ise-uellegar maid, burgwedani maid. A-dulede, na e-mai nue-sabed.
Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid dulemar-Jesúsʼgi-sunmak-itoargu, Jesúsʼse Judío-girmar-dummagan barmialid, adi, Jesúsʼga sogega e-negse dagye, e-mai ega nudakdaye.
Judío-dummagan Jesúsʼse nonimargu, egi nue-wilenai gusmalad, ega weyob sognanai gusmalad: “We-dule-e-mai wis be bendakergebed,
ar Roma-sordamar-dummadde, anmar-neggwebur-nue-sabed, degine, anmarga onmakedneg sobsabalid.”

Jesús amarba nadsunnad. Neg-modanigusgu, Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid Jesús-abin e-aimar barmialid. Adi, amar Jesúsʼga weyob sogmalagar: “Dummad, an-negse be dogsulir, akarsulid, ar be an-negse gwen dogedwilubsulid,
degine, an bese gwen dagedsurmoganad. Ar unnila be sogsa-sae, an-mai yog-nuguar naoed.

”Amba an dummad nikmogad, a-sogedba an damogad. Degine, ani an dummadmogad, ani an sordamar-sedimogad. Ar sorda-wargwenga an sogdibe: ‘Be nae,’ yog naar daed. Sorda-baidga an sogbardibe: ‘Be dage,’ yog dagar daed. Degine, an-maiga an sogdibe: ‘Be we-imake,’ yog-imakar daed.”

Jesús deyob Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid ega ibmar-soge itoargu, geger-itoded. Geb degi, Jesús dulemar-e-sorba-duurmakdanimaladga sogded: “An bemarga sogmar, gwen an Israel-yargi weyob dule-angi-nue-bensulid an dakdisulid.”
Ar dule-barmilesmalad gannar negse nonimargu, daknonimalad, mai-uellemai-gusad bato nugusa. Ar ade, bato Jesús bannapaa we-dule nudaksad.
Jesús, ome-ei-sui-burgwisadga machi-odulosad
Jesús, Roma-sordamar-dummad-e-mai-nudaksad-sorba, Naínʼye-neggwebur-nugadse nadapgu, e-sapingan eba nadapi gusmarmogad, degine, bukidar dule-baigan eba nadapi gusmarmogad.

Neggweburse-doged-yawagak-mosgu, dulemar neg-uanse dule-burgwisad-dignadapi gusmalad. A-burgwaled, ome-ei-sui-burgwisad-e-machi-wargwensakadid. Naín-neggweburginmalad bukidar a-omeba nadapi gusmarmogad.
Agi Dummad-Jesús dakargu, nue-wile a-ome-dakded, ega sogded: —Mer be boe.
Jesús dule-burgwar-maid-selemaidse warmakdapgu, dule-mui-semamaid gwisgusmalad. Geb degi, Jesús a-egi-selemaid-ebusgu, sogded: —Sapingwa, an bega soge, be gwisgu.
Geb degi, dule-burgwar-maid gwisgusad, geb agi yog sunmakdeguad. Geb Jesús a-sapingwa e-nanse sessunnad.
Bela-dulemar dobee itodmalad, geb degi, Bab-Dummad-nug odummodmalad, sogdemalad: “Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-wargwen anmar-abargi gwisgunoni. Bab-Dummad na e-dulemarse ataknoni.”
Bela Judea-yalaganba, degi, neggweburmar-a-dikarba-bubukwad bela Jesús dule-burgwaled-odulosad wisguarmalad.
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan, Jesúsʼse e-sapingan-barmialid
Deunni, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-e-sapingan bela Jesús-ibmar-imaksad Juanʼga sognonimalad. Agi Juan na e-sapingan-warbose gochad.
Geb Jesúsʼse barmisad, adi, ese egisegar: —Ar epenne Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-an-bemarga-barmidagoye-sogsadi, ¿ar be a-dule? ¿Anmar dule-baid amba edarbemaloe?

Dule-warbo-barmilearmalad Jesúsʼse nonimalad, ega sognonimalad: —Anmar bese ibmar-egisega Diigi-dule-oged-Juan anmar-barmialid. Bega sogega, bede, Bab-Dummad-epenne-dule-wargwen-an-bemarga-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-sogeye. Anmar dule-baid amba edarbemalo-sogeye.
Agine, Jesús, Juan-sapingan-wagab, bukidar dulemar-gegumalad, galagwensuli-bonigan-nikmalad, niaburba-nikmalad, degine, dulemar-ibyasurmalad nudaksad.
Geb degi, Jesús, Juan-sapingan-abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Be namar, Juanʼga be ibmar-itosmalad sognamar, degi, ega be ibmar-daksamalad sognamar:

content.text: degine, dulemar-wileganaga Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi an ega sunmaknonikid.

content: ”Degine, Juanʼga be sogbalo: ‘Ar dule-an-bensuliddi, a-dulegindi nued binsalesye.’ ”
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-sapingan-warbogwad nadmargu, Jesús, Juanʼgi dulemarga sunmakalid, sogded: “¿Ar ibiga nega-dulesulidganba bemar arbisunna? ¿Nargammu-burwaba-aibangwichi-dakega bemar arbi? Suli.
”Degite, ¿ar ibi-dakega bemar arbisunna? ¿Bemar dule-wargwen-mor-nued-yoi-gudiid-dakega arbimala? Suli. Ar dulemar mor-nued-yoi-gudimaladdi, wergudimalad, amardi reymar-negyagi gudidimalad.

”Ar degite, ¿ibi-dakega bemar arbimarsunna? ¿Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-dakegala? Eye. An bemarga sogmalad, a be daksamalad, degine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedba bur bule bemar daksamalad, ar ade, we-bur-dule-dummadid.
Ar we-dulegine bato narmakar sognaid, Mesíasʼgi sunmaknaigu, Bab-Dummad soged:
Malaquías 3:1 We-gayaburba-barsoged, Diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼdo.
”Ani an bemarga soged: Dulemar we-napneggi-gwalulemaid, Diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼba bur-dummad sated. Ar degite, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidgi bur dule-bipigwadi, Juanʼba bur-dule-dummadid.”
Bela dulemar Jesús-itosmalad, degi, Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamaladse-bakar, sogdemalad, Bab-Dummad-igar-napira-maid inniki-maiye, ar amar, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan-diigi-ogedgi oglesmalad.
Ar Fariseoʼmardi, degi, Moisés-Igar-odulomaladdi, Bab-Dummad-igar-emarga-uklenaid gwen abingassurmalad, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar Juan-imakedi, gwen imaksasurmalad.
Geb degi, Jesús sogdebalid: “Degite, emi we-dulemar-bukmaladde, ¿ibubo wilubdakar an egi sunmakoe? ¿Doa sunnaa damar be insae?
Wemar-damaladi, masmala dulemar-bukidar-ambikuedgi ambikumaladyobdo. Ar dulemar-bukidar-ambikumaladgi muchub-muchub na gorbukmalad. Weyob sogbukwa damalad:
”Diigi-dule-oged-Juan we-napnegse nonigu, dule-baiganyob mas-gunsuli, degi, gobsuli gudigusad. E-annik bemar sogsamalad: ‘Wedi nia egi naiye.’
”Ani Dule-Machi, andi nonigu, mas gunnonikid, gobnonikid, an-annik be sogmalad:
Geb degine, Jesús sogded: “Ar dule Bab-Dummad-e-ibmar-wisidi, ibmar-nuegan-imakedgi mag dakledaed.”
Jesús, Fariseo-Simónʼye-nugad-negse mas gunnapid
Ibagwengine, Fariseo-wargwen Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad, e-negse mas gunnaegar. Jesús, Fariseo-negyaba dogsagua, mese-naba mas gunnega sigidapid.
A-neggweburgine, ome-wargwen, ome-isgudiid-dule, itoargu, Jesús, Fariseo-neggi mas-gunsiiye, gwallu-wawagwad alabastro-akwagi-bute-sobaledgi senonikid.

Ome Jesús-yarganba, e-mali-dikarba ise-boar signonikid. Agi, ome na e-ibyanisgi Jesús-e-mali owardikusad. Geb degi, e-sailagiagi odinnosbalid. Ome Jesús-mali suk imaksad, gwallu-wawad Jesús-maligi eosbalid.

Fariseo-Jesúsʼnik-gochadi degi-daksagua, na e-gwagegi binsasigualid: “Ar Jesús, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogeddina, wisindo, we-ome, doa-dule, degine, we-ome-e-ebunaidi, igidaedbali. Ar we-ome isgudiid-duled.”
Geb degi, Jesús sunmakdegu, sogded: —Simón, ibmar-gwensak an bega sogbido. Simón, abin-sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, be soge.
Jesús sogded: —Dulemar-walabo dule-gwensakgi mani gasmalad: Wargwen egi dulataled-ilatar (500) mani gasad, baiddi, dulatar (100) egi mani gasad.
Ar ebobela geg bennuke gusmalad. Degisoggu, mani-ibed amarga sogsagusad: ‘Akarsurye, mer bar an-bennukmaloye.’ Emide, be anga sogena: We-dule, ¿doa bur sab be insae?
Simón, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —An insagua, bur dumma-egi-mani-ganigusad, an insado. Jesús, abin-sogded: —Napiragwad be sogsado.

Jesús ome-siidsik aibilisgua, Simónʼga sogded: —We-ome be dakena. An be-negse dognonigu, gwen be anga an-nag enukega dii uksasulid. Ar we-omedi e-ibyanisgi an-nag enuksad, degine, e-sailagiagi anga an-nag odinnosbalid.
Dog-nued-noniye be anga sogega, be an-wagar ussulid. Ar we-omedi an be-negse dogsad-akar an-nag usiguad.
”Be an-nonogi anga gwallu-wawad gwen eossulid, ar we-omedi an-naggi gwallu-wawad eosad.
Ar degisoggu, an bega sogsun, we-ome-dummad-isgudiid ega bela elilesad, ar ade, we-omede dummad-an-sabgusad. Ar dule unnila ichee ega isgued-elilesale, ichee sabgumogad.”
Geb degi, Jesús omega sogded: —Be-gwagegi be isgudigusad nugussun.
Dulemar-mesegi-eba-mas-gunbukmalad, na ulubgi binsadmalad, sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede doa-dulesunna, isguedse-bakar, elied?
Ar Jesúsʼdi omega sogded: —Be-angi-bensulidba isguedgi be abonolesun. Degisoggu, ulubgi gwage-bogidikidba be nasun.
